title: Reality-first broad re-entry after fluid-cognition reset
mission: Resume broad public-web discovery under REALITY > COGNITION > SCHEMA. Do not force Scan 026's CURRENT_EXTERNALIZED_WORKAROUND_FIRST heuristic as the only entrance. Preserve any evidence-bearing entry point and promote only when reality supports it.

coverage.note: Coverage readiness means broad research context only; it is not opportunity confirmation.
coverage.source_diversity_note: The sweep used well over the configured minimum host/source-family diversity and deliberately included incumbent/counterevidence searches.

reality_observations.observation: China's August 2026 economy remained broadly stable while service consumption outgrew total market sales and information/software employment expanded; this is context, not a business thesis.
Jiangsu Jan-Aug 2026 trade reached 4.87 trillion yuan, up 27.5%; machinery/electrical exports rose 32.8%, creating a large current surface for overseas service, compliance and localization needs.

Jiangsu is explicitly building an integrated overseas-service system with a 2.0 platform, 40 overseas service points, department/service integration and professional legal/finance/tax/IP/consulting capacity.

Jiangsu's July 2026 scene-opening policy explicitly calls for market-oriented scene supply-demand matching and professional organizations that coordinate scene resources and commercialize new technology/products.

Xuzhou Guoji Atomic Manufacturing has already produced special-metal atomic-cluster powder but publicly states that downstream application is still an open question and it is seeking application partners.

The same Xuzhou expert-enterprise program documents manufacturers with hard-to-articulate technical problems and shows a technical manager translating a vague equipment problem into a technical-demand list before matching experts.

Jiangsu's 2026 technical-manager-office rules create a formal market rail: offices may recruit/attach technical managers via project cooperation, settle technical-transfer commissions by agreement, sign service contracts, invoice and obtain service income.

The same 2026 rules explicitly encourage professional/social technical managers to establish partnership or OPC operating entities and allow such applicants to be exempt from the ordinary scale/history conditions for market-oriented technical-manager-office construction.

Jiangsu's market-oriented technology-transfer policy allows eligible social technology-transfer institutions that facilitate major transfers to receive a subsidy equal to 3% of technology transaction value, capped at 1 million yuan per institution; this is an institutional incentive, not a promised private commission rate.

J-TOP's August 2026 advanced-materials session reported 200+ technical demands, 20 signed projects and over 11 million yuan of facilitated technology transactions, demonstrating a live transaction rail rather than only policy intent.

Xuzhou already has active technical-transfer infrastructure: nearly 1000 certified technical managers are reported locally; one university-science-park office facilitated 8 technical contracts worth nearly 2 million yuan in 2024; the Jiangsu Huaihai Technology Property Rights Trading Center is locally established.

Generic resource-first application discovery is not empty whitespace: Jiangsu concept-validation centers already offer product/scene-system verification, commercial-prospect validation and, in new materials, key application-scene screening and market validation.

Xuzhou's machinery export ecosystem contains real recurring overseas-service control work; XCMG currently recruits for overseas service/network/parts management and long-term overseas technical service.

Large Xuzhou manufacturers can internalize the global-service problem: XCMG reports 300+ overseas dealers, 2000+ overseas service/parts outlets and 10,000+ localized service engineers, so XCMG itself is not evidence of an open third-party routing gap.

The overseas/industrial after-sales category already has meaningful incumbents spanning software, call-center operations, engineer matching and partner networks; generic 'overseas after-sales platform' is therefore not whitespace.
EU CBAM is in its definitive regime from 2026 and accredited-verifier registration/first verification starts in September 2026, creating genuine compliance work for exporters.

Generic CBAM/DPP/carbon-data orchestration is already being productized end-to-end by multiple providers, including supplier collaboration, traceability, digital product passports, verification support and managed compliance.

main_learning: A fresh whole-web scan does not need to invent a new category to create value; discovering a legitimate existing transaction rail can be commercially superior to building another marketplace.
Technical transfer has a current formal commission-bearing rail in Jiangsu, including project cooperation and an OPC/partnership path, but competition and access terms remain real constraints.
Resource-first application discovery is a genuine formation pattern, but concept-validation and technical-transfer incumbents mean the missing edge must be observed after those routes are considered.

Rapid export growth creates overseas-service pressure, but broad after-sales categories are already productized; the possible residual is narrower: qualified long-tail on-site technical responsibility for smaller exporters.
The new reality-first constitution improved the scan by allowing multiple entry points instead of mechanically staying inside CURRENT_EXTERNALIZED_WORKAROUND_FIRST.
next_action: Run a bounded Scan 028 on R027-TRACK-A first: use public evidence to map the exact entry/qualification/commission rail for a project-based technical manager through existing Xuzhou/Jiangsu offices, while separately continuing named-actor evidence collection for Tracks B and C. Do not contact anyone until a specific bounded probe is written and explicitly authorized.
